sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A young marquis with unparalleled influence in Lumelux. Having received the guidance of his partner, the spirit of the Flame Lion, he grew up humble and steadfast. Never boasting about his noble birth. His most cherished friend was a commoner of lower class. They fostered a strong bond since childhood, but because of the his lower class system, his friend was unfairly accused and unjustly exiled. Ever since then, the marquis has been tormented by doubts about a system that divides people based on birthright. He proposed reforms to the social system numerous times, but even with his stature, his pleas fell on deaf ears.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Dawn Lord Cristoph |bf2 = true }} '''Cristoph''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A young marquis with unparalleled influence in Lumelux. Having received the guidance of his partner, the spirit of the Flame Lion, he grew up humble and steadfast. Never boasting about his noble birth. His most cherished friend was a commoner of lower class. They fostered a strong bond since childhood, but because of the his lower class system, his friend was unfairly accused and unjustly exiled. Ever since then, the marquis has been tormented by doubts about a system that divides people based on birthright. He proposed reforms to the social system numerous times, but even with his stature, his pleas fell on deaf ears. ==Artwork== {{CharacterImage |name = Cristoph |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 196 0.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 196 1.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 196 2.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 196 3.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 196 4.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 196 5.png |image6note = Hurt }} {{CharacterImage |name = Cristoph with Flame Lion Spirit |element = Fire |image1 = Navi chara bf2 196 6.png |image1note = Neutral |image2 = Navi chara bf2 196 7.png |image2note = Happy |image3 = Navi chara bf2 196 8.png |image3note = Angry |image4 = Navi chara bf2 196 9.png |image4note = Sad |image5 = Navi chara bf2 196 10.png |image5note = Shock |image6 = Navi chara bf2 196 11.png |image6note = Hurt }} ==Trivia==
